description: Phase 3 (#55) v0.3.0 evaluation corpus. Fifteen fixtures covering the full 5-workstream x 3-class matrix (happy / policy_fail / interrupt_retry). v0.3.0 grows the corpus from v0.2.0's 5 fixtures to 15 by adding: session-ingest-secret-redact / drift-replay, distill-no-hallucination / partial-apply, loadout-cas-mismatch, skills-kebab-case / append-cas, bootstrap-scan-idempotent / unsafe-path / apply-partial. Closes the (workstream, class) coverage gap that v0.2.0 left in the ingestion workstream.
